what: A first-impression pass on the web view in daemon/src/prismis_daemon/static/index.html: a help modal opened by ? or a header button with an identity banner showing the running version (#53), a redesigned status bar (#41), and phone-width treatment of the article detail panel and its deep-synthesis card (#40), proven in a real browser.
why: The web view is prismis's lowest-friction entry point and the measure is adoption; today it has no in-app guidance, a status bar that reads as placeholder, and a synthesis card whose section headings are unstyled and whose detail panel has no phone-width rules, so a first visitor meets an unfinished product.
decided: The three issues ship as one work order because all three touch only the web view's first impression and the same file.

The help modal opens on ? or a (?) header button, closes on Esc or ?, and describes only controls the web view actually has: votes, Mark Read, the sort and kind selects, the summary click that opens the detail panel, the audio briefing, priority meanings, the learned marker and the duplicate badge.
Esc also closes the article detail panel, which has no keyboard close today.
The identity banner shows the running daemon version, read from a new version field on the existing unauthenticated /health endpoint.

#41 redesigns only what the status bar holds today (the counts line, the kind and sort selects, the refresh countdown); filter chips and an archived toggle named in #41 do not exist and are not built.
The dead .filter-tabs rules in the 768px media query are removed.
#40 styles the h4 headings renderSimpleMarkdown emits inside .detail-synthesis, and adds phone-width rules for the detail panel, the synthesis card and the quotes.
#42's palette and visual-identity decision stays out; the existing colors are kept.

Proof is Playwright browser tests in the daemon test suite that load the real page: ? opens and Esc closes the help modal, Esc closes the detail panel, and no horizontal overflow at 375, 768 and 1024 px widths.
